Specification of Diagnostics
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
Most interaction between DM and application is realized by instances of ara::diag
classes. The application instantiates the ara::diag objects and uses the provided in-
terface to interact with the DM. The application itself can be deployed anywhere. They
can run in the local
SoftwareCluster
, but also remote on other
SoftwareClus-
ter
s or even other hardware is possible.
7.3.1.1 MetaInfo class
The
ara::diag::MetaInfo
class specifies a mechanism to provide meta infor-
mation, i.e. from transport protocol layer, to an interested application. To support
this,
ara::diag::MetaInfo::GetValue
is specified, which provides the accord-
ing value represented as a
ara::core::StringView
. The context of the current request
may also be retrieved by an application by calling
ara::diag::MetaInfo::Get-
Context
. The context of a request could be either
kDiagnosticCommunication
,
kFaultMemory
or
kDoIP
. The detailed information on meanings of the context and
key-value pairs can be looked up in Table 7.1 “MetaInfo type definition”.
